birth_rate.short_description: Share of women aged 15–50 who gave birth in the past 12 months.
birth_rate.long_description: Proportion of women aged 15–50 years who gave birth in the past 12 months, derived from ACS Table B13002. Used as an approximation of the general fertility rate.
birth_rate.statement: In {location}, {value} of women aged 15–50 gave birth in the past year.

teen_birth_rate.short_description: Number of births per 1,000 female population ages 15-19.
teen_birth_rate.long_description: Number of births per 1,000 female population ages 15-19, from the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) Natality files.
teen_birth_rate.statement: In {location}, there were {value} births per 1,000 females ages 15-19.

low_birth_weight.short_description: Percentage of live births with low birth weight (< 2,500 grams).
low_birth_weight.long_description: Percentage of live births with low birth weight (< 2,500 grams), from the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) Natality files.
low_birth_weight.statement: In {location}, {value}% of live births had low birth weight.

infant_mortality.short_description: Number of infant deaths (within 1 year) per 1,000 live births.
infant_mortality.long_description: Number of infant deaths (within 1 year) per 1,000 live births, from the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) Linked Birth/Infant Death data. Note: the corrupt 2013 CHR release of this measure is excluded in the bundle build.
infant_mortality.statement: In {location}, the infant mortality rate was {value} per 1,000 live births.

child_mortality.short_description: Number of deaths among residents under age 20 per 100,000 population.
child_mortality.long_description: Number of deaths among residents under age 20 per 100,000 population, from the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) Multiple Cause of Death files.
child_mortality.statement: In {location}, the child mortality rate was {value} per 100,000 population under 20.

smoking_during_pregnancy.short_description: Percentage of women who smoked during pregnancy.
smoking_during_pregnancy.long_description: Percentage of women who reported smoking during pregnancy, from the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) Natality files. Coverage is limited; not all states/counties report this measure in every release year.
smoking_during_pregnancy.statement: In {location}, {value} of women smoked during pregnancy.

breastfeeding.short_description: Percentage of infants who were ever breastfed.
breastfeeding.long_description: Percentage of infants who were ever breastfed. Coverage is sparse; reported for only a small number of state/county-years in the County Health Rankings data.
breastfeeding.statement: In {location}, {value} of infants were ever breastfed.

medicaid_prenatal_postpartum_care_adult.short_description: Percent of adult women (Medicaid) who received timely prenatal and postpartum care.
medicaid_prenatal_postpartum_care_adult.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (PPC). Percentage of women aged 21–44 enrolled in Medicaid who had a live birth and received a prenatal care visit in the first trimester and a postpartum visit within 21–56 days of delivery. State-level, Medicaid payer.
medicaid_prenatal_postpartum_care_adult.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adult women received timely prenatal and postpartum care.

medicaid_prenatal_postpartum_care_child.short_description: Percent of adolescent females (Medicaid) who received timely prenatal and postpartum care.
medicaid_prenatal_postpartum_care_child.long_description: Child Core Set measure (PPC). Percentage of adolescent females aged 15–20 enrolled in Medicaid who had a live birth and received a prenatal care visit in the first trimester and a postpartum visit within 21–56 days of delivery. State-level, Medicaid payer.
medicaid_prenatal_postpartum_care_child.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescent mothers received timely prenatal and postpartum care.

medicaid_first_prenatal_visit.short_description: Percent of adolescent females (Medicaid) with a first-trimester prenatal visit.
medicaid_first_prenatal_visit.long_description: Child Core Set measure (FPC). Percentage of adolescent females aged 15–20 enrolled in Medicaid who had a live birth and received a prenatal care visit in the first trimester. State-level, Medicaid payer.
medicaid_first_prenatal_visit.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescent mothers received first-trimester prenatal care.

medicaid_contraceptive_postpartum_adult.short_description: Percent of adult women (Medicaid) with a live birth who received postpartum contraceptive care.
medicaid_contraceptive_postpartum_adult.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (CPA). Percentage of women aged 21–44 enrolled in Medicaid who had a live birth and received a most or moderately effective contraceptive method within 60 days of delivery. State-level, Medicaid payer.
medicaid_contraceptive_postpartum_adult.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adult women received postpartum contraceptive care.

medicaid_contraceptive_postpartum_child.short_description: Percent of adolescent females (Medicaid) with a live birth who received postpartum contraceptive care.
medicaid_contraceptive_postpartum_child.long_description: Child Core Set measure (CPC). Percentage of adolescent females aged 15–20 enrolled in Medicaid who had a live birth and received a most or moderately effective contraceptive method within 60 days of delivery. State-level, Medicaid payer.
medicaid_contraceptive_postpartum_child.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescent females received postpartum contraceptive care.

medicaid_low_birthweight.long_name: Live Births Weighing Less Than 2,500 Grams (Medicaid)
medicaid_low_birthweight.short_description: Percent of live births (Medicaid/CHIP) weighing less than 2,500 grams.
medicaid_low_birthweight.long_description: Child Core Set measure (LBW). Percentage of live singleton deliveries to Medicaid-enrolled women that resulted in a low birthweight infant (less than 2,500 grams). Lower rates indicate better outcomes. State-level, Medicaid payer.
medicaid_low_birthweight.statement: In {location}, {value}% of Medicaid births resulted in low birthweight.

medicaid_low_birthweight_risk_adjusted.long_name: Live Births Weighing Less Than 2,500 Grams – Risk-Adjusted (Medicaid)
medicaid_low_birthweight_risk_adjusted.short_description: Risk-adjusted percent of live births (Medicaid) weighing less than 2,500 grams.
medicaid_low_birthweight_risk_adjusted.long_description: Child Core Set measure (LRCD). Risk-adjusted version of the low birthweight measure: percentage of live singleton deliveries resulting in low birthweight, adjusted for clinical and demographic risk factors. State-level, Medicaid payer.
medicaid_low_birthweight_risk_adjusted.statement: In {location}, the risk-adjusted low birthweight rate was {value}%.

acs5.name: American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates
acs5.location: Census API — ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables (Table B13002)
acs5.description: The American Community Survey (ACS) is an ongoing survey by the U.S. Census Bureau providing detailed demographic, social, economic, and housing data. The 5-year estimates pool 60 months of data for greater reliability in small geographies. The maternal bundle uses ACS Table B13002 to derive the share of women aged 15–50 who gave birth in the past 12 months, an approximation of the general fertility rate.
acs5.restrictions: Public domain. U.S. Census Bureau data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

chr.name: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps
chr.organization: University of Wisconsin Population Health Institute
chr.location: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps Annual Data
chr.description: The County Health Rankings & Roadmaps (CHR&R) program, a collaboration between the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation and the University of Wisconsin Population Health Institute, compiles county- and state-level health measures from sources including the NCHS Natality, Linked Birth/Infant Death, and Multiple Cause of Death files. The maternal bundle draws teen births, low birth weight, infant mortality, child mortality, smoking during pregnancy, and breastfeeding from CHR&R. Released annually, 2010–present.
chr.restrictions: CC BY 4.0. Attribution required. Cite as: University of Wisconsin Population Health Institute. County Health Rankings & Roadmaps. https://www.countyhealthrankings.org.

medicaid_quality_cms.name: Medicaid and CHIP Adult and Child Core Set Quality Measures
medicaid_quality_cms.location: Medicaid.gov Open Data – Quality Measures datasets (2014–2023)
medicaid_quality_cms.description: Annual state-level performance data on the Medicaid and CHIP Adult and Child Core Set quality measures, voluntarily reported by states to CMS. The maternal bundle uses the Maternal and Perinatal Health domain measures (prenatal and postpartum care, first prenatal visit, postpartum contraceptive care, and low birthweight), restricted to the Medicaid payer. State-level only; values are state rates.
medicaid_quality_cms.restrictions: Public domain. CMS/Medicaid.gov data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
